summary: Updates now install only between runs, so a running job is never disturbed.

new.title: Updates wait for running jobs
new.text: When an update is due, new jobs wait and the update installs only after running jobs finish. If they take over 45 minutes, it tries again the next night.

fixes.title: Do not install this release
fixes.text: This release was replaced by 2.0.76, because its update stops before installing anything. Use 2.0.76 or later.
